# FolkUp

> An independent open-content workshop in Setúbal, Portugal: free encyclopedias, an open non-fiction book series, slow investigations and a public declaration. One author — Comandante FolkUp — and a named team of AI assistants. Everything is signed, sourced and published under CC BY-SA 4.0 (content) and MIT (code). No ads, no registration, no paywalls.

## How we work
- Every text follows the same road: draft → fact-checking against sources → editing → signature. Each publication names who wrote, who verified and who edited it.
- AI use is disclosed voluntarily for every publication (EU AI Act, Art. 50(4)): https://folkup.app/en/about/ai-use
- Languages: English, Russian, Portuguese (European), German. Not every page exists in every language yet; where a translation is missing, the page says so.

## Books — FolkUp Library
- [Library](https://books.folkup.life/en): the open book series — read online, download EPUB. Three trilogies: «By Our Own Means», «Firsthand», «Common Ground».
- [Agile Sapiens](https://books.folkup.life/en/kn1): the first book — a literary analysis of management (Verne, Shelley, Holmes, Borges). RU, EN, PT, DE.
- [Lost in Conversation](https://books.folkup.life/kn7): the newest book, first of «Common Ground». Russian; translations in the workshop.

## Encyclopedias (all free, all sourced)
- [Setúbal](https://setubal.folkup.city/): a Portuguese city where the mountains meet the sea — markets, routes, history. EN/RU/PT.
- [Padel](https://padel.folkup.fit/): the sport — rules, technique, courts, gear, tournaments. EN/RU/PT.
- [Cogumelos](https://cogumelos.folkup.fit/): mushrooms of Portugal — which to eat, which to photograph from a distance; toxicity warnings first. RU/EN.
- [Dialup](https://dialup.folkup.city/): the Russian internet of the dial-up era — software, hardware, culture. RU.
- [Aquarium](https://aquarium.folkup.city/): encyclopedia of the band Аквариум and fifty years of Russian rock. RU.
- [Tarot](https://tarot.folkup.life/): tarot encyclopedia (Rider–Waite). RU/EN; work paused.

## Research
- [Lucerna](https://lucerna.folkup.app/): open OSINT laboratory — investigations from open sources, public verification methodology.
- [Underground Academia](https://underground.folkup.life/): long-form cultural research.

## Declaration
- [The Unenclosed Knowledge Declaration](https://declaration.folkup.app/): seven principles against the enclosure of the mind; open for signature by any person or organization. A teenage edition is in the workshop.

## Commissions
- [Commissions](https://folkup.app/en/services): what we made for ourselves we can make for you — an encyclopedia turn-key, a research book with full apparatus, a translation with apparatus and a living reader; and, case by case, a home on our infrastructure for open-licensed work. Typical cycle from three months. No prices online — by conversation.
